quality.basis: 崩溃差分（fuzz harness 输入），判定端固定分配上限使 calloc 失败可达；没有标准答案

ground_truth_evidence: category 5: none: the dataset's input is 200M invalid H3 cells (reserved high bit set) that validateCellSet rejects before the changed code, and libFuzzer OOMs loading the 1.6 GB file on both builds; the injected NULL-check removal is reachable only when a calloc fails, which no dataset input arranges.

review.note: a 1.6 GB input meant to make calloc fail (the injected bug is on that failure path); libFuzzer runs out of memory on both builds

category5.design: The injected code removes the NULL check after the hash-bucket calloc in createArcSet, so a failed bucket calloc leaves buckets=NULL and the insert loop dereferences it. The judge fixes an ASan allocation cap (allocator_may_return_null=1:max_allocation_size_mb=64): with ~140k-233k valid, distinct, same-resolution cells the buckets calloc (480 bytes/cell) exceeds 64 MiB and returns NULL while the arcs malloc (288 bytes/cell) fits, so the vulnerable build crashes in createArcSet and the secure build returns E_MEMORY_ALLOC. No dataset input triggers this, so there is no ground truth.
